prerequisites: Install Java JDK 21 and ensure JAVA_HOME environment variable is set.
Install Android Command Line Tools / SDK Manager.
Set ANDROID_HOME environment variable to your Android SDK path.
Add $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin and $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools to your system PATH.
steps: Ensure local.properties has 'sdk.dir' correctly pointing to your Android SDK directory.
Navigate to the 'android' subdirectory of the project: cd android
Run the Gradle wrapper assemble task: ./gradlew assembleDebug
The generated APK will be available in: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
